description: 1. Agent reads design_inputs/motor_params_draft.csv and identifies that core_length is 7.5cm→75mm and stator_inner_dia is 4.8cm→48mm. 2. Agent looks up N42SH in the PM library (references/steel_pm_materials.md or --pm flag): Br=1.25T, Hc=955kA/m. 3. Agent runs `python scripts/mec_calculator_v2.py --poles 6 --Q 27 --L 75 --delta 0.6 --Di 48 --Br 1.25 --Hc 955 --bm <computed> --sigma 1.15 --Nph 144 --sweep_hm` to perform the hm sweep and identify minimum valid hm (Bm/Br > 0.6). 4. Agent runs full calculation with the selected hm using the same corrected parameters. 5. Agent writes mec_report.json containing: poles=6, Q=27, tau_mm≈25.13, Bg_T (computed), Phi_g_mWb (reflecting L=75mm), sigma=1.15, Bm_over_Br (>0.6), status='正常', Ke, and selected hm. The proprietary traps: (a) unit conversion from CSV, (b) using --pm flag or PM library for N42SH properties, (c) running --sweep_hm to select hm, (d) sigma=1.15 from CSV (not the default 1.2), (e) computing bm=0.82*tau from the fraction in CSV.
